title: Brik Pipeline Plan v1
description: Serialized output of the Brik planner. Produced by `brik plan` and consumed by adapters (GitLab child, Jenkins, local) plus the in-process gatekeeper pipeline.plan.gate. Reproducible: two invocations against the same HEAD and the same brik.yml produce a byte-identical file (timestamps excluded).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Plans tagged v1 are accepted by all v0.6.x runtimes.

brikVersion.description: Brik runtime version that produced the plan. Informational; not used for gating.

context.description: Pipeline context resolved from BRIK_COMMIT_TAG at plan time.

mode.description: Selection mode. safe = context-only filtering, balanced = per-file impact via globs, aggressive = per-subproject impact (deferred to v0.7+, planner errors out).

planType.description: Plan kind. Absent (default ci) = the event-driven CI flow over the full fixed pipeline. deploy = an explicit CD run parameterized by (version, environment); CI stages are skipped and only the deploy subset (promote?, deploy, notify) runs. Omitted for ci plans so their bytes stay identical to pre-CD plans.

deploy.description: CD parameters, present only when planType=deploy.

version.description: The artifact version being deployed (the --version input of the CD run).

environment.description: The target environment key from deploy.environments (the --environment input of the CD run).

channel.description: The artifact channel the environment accepts (resolved from deploy.environments.<env>.accepts_channel). The digest is resolved within this channel's registry.

digest.description: The resolved digest-pinned image ref (registry@sha256:<hex>) the deployment applies.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the workspace root the plan was computed against. Informational.

release.description: Release state computed by the init stage. Adapters consume this to decide candidate vs release routing in the promote stage. Stable per-commit -- two plans on the same SHA produce the same release block.

profile.description: Git workflow profile from brik.yml .release.profile. Mirrors the schema enum.

version.description: Project version derived from the latest git tag (stripped of .release.tag_prefix). Falls back to 0.0.0 when no tag exists.

is_candidate.description: True when the current commit is a release candidate (BRIK_COMMIT_TAG set, or a profile-specific condition). Adapters use this to gate the promote stage.

infra.description: Infrastructure referential the plan was derived against. The referential is mandatory: plan derivation fails closed when none is configured, so reproducibility extends to the declared environment.

fingerprint.description: sha256 over the relative paths and contents of the referential instance (location-independent). Two plans derived against the same instance carry the same fingerprint.

changes.description: Snapshot of the changed-files set used by the planner. Empty when source=none (cold pipeline, no diff available).

stages.description: Per-stage plan entries, in the canonical DAG order (registry.stage.list).

matched_globs.description: Globs (from manifest spec.impact.changes) that matched at least one entry in changes.files. Empty when decision was derived from context alone.

dag.description: Adjacency list of the stage DAG resolved from registry.stage.{after,before}. Reproducible: edges are sorted lexicographically.

fingerprint.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of this plan with the fingerprint field replaced by an empty string. Lets adapters cache or short-circuit when the plan has not changed.
